PSYCHIATRIC ASSESSMENT REPORT FOR THE INTERNATIONAL PROTECTION APPEALS TRIBUNAL
Appellant: Christian Manicaro, DOB 29/09/1969
Date of report: 17 September 2026

1. Instructions, sources and consent
I was instructed by the appellant's legal representative to give an independent opinion on Mr Manicaro's mental health and on whether his presentation is consistent with the detention and ill-treatment he describes. I saw him on 3 and 10 September 2026, jointly with Saviour Tagliaferro, Clinical Psychologist, with a Spanish interpreter on both occasions. He gave written consent for this report to be disclosed to the Tribunal. Contact for arranging follow-up (via his lawyer): mobile +356 9916 1724.

2. Background
Mr Manicaro is a 56-year-old Venezuelan national of Maltese descent. He now works as a warehouse operative in Malta. He reports that he was a member of the opposition party Voluntad Popular and in 2019 organised neighbourhood protests in his district. In 2024 he was detained for 11 days.

3. Account of detention
He describes repeated beatings with batons, being held in a crowded cell without light, and threats against his family. Guards insulted him because he is gay, something he had hidden from his relatives at the time. His daughter, Doris, now lives with him in Malta. His account was detailed and internally consistent across both interviews, and his affect matched the content.

4. Current symptoms
- nightmares several nights a week
- intrusive flashbacks triggered by shouting and the sound of keys
- hypervigilance and exaggerated startle
- insomnia, about 4 hours of sleep a night
- avoidance of uniformed security staff at work, which has led him to change his route through the warehouse

5. Psychometric testing and mental state
PCL-5 score 58 (probable PTSD threshold 31-33). PHQ-9 score 19 (moderately severe). No psychotic features. He reports passive death wishes but no suicidal plans or intent; protective factors are his daughter and his faith in the appeal.

6. Opinion
In my opinion Mr Manicaro meets the criteria for post-traumatic stress disorder (ICD-11 6B40) and a moderate depressive episode. Applying the Istanbul Protocol, his psychological findings are highly consistent with the detention and ill-treatment he describes.

7. Treatment and prognosis
He has started sertraline 50 mg once daily and has been offered 12 sessions of trauma-focused CBT with Mr Tagliaferro. Removal to Venezuela would, in my view, carry a high risk of marked deterioration, including increased suicide risk, and would interrupt treatment. He will be reviewed in 6 weeks.

8. Statement of truth
I confirm that the facts stated are true to the best of my knowledge and the opinions are my own. I understand that my duty is to the Tribunal and overrides any obligation to the party instructing me.

Dr Daniela Demajo, Consultant in Psychiatry
Saviour Tagliaferro, Clinical Psychologist

Mr Ollie Seoighe

Dear Ollie,

Your results after surgery

As you asked, I am writing to explain your results in plain language. A copy goes to your family doctor in Valletta, Dr Marthese Vancell.

What the surgery found
The part of the bowel removed at your right hemicolectomy in September contained a stage II colon cancer (pT3 N0). The cancer had grown into the bowel wall but none of the 24 lymph nodes removed contained cancer (0 of 24), and the margins were clear, meaning the surgeon removed it completely.

Your scan
Your CT scan of the chest, abdomen and pelvis showed no evidence of spread to the liver, lungs or elsewhere.

The special tests
Tests on the tumour showed loss of the MLH1 protein (MMR-deficient). Because of this we tested your blood for an inherited cause. This showed an MLH1 pathogenic variant, which means you have Lynch syndrome. Lynch syndrome raises the risk of bowel cancer and some other cancers, which is why regular checks matter.

What this means for treatment
You do not need chemotherapy. For stage II cancers with this tumour type, chemotherapy does not add benefit. Instead we will keep a close watch:
- Colonoscopy in 1 year (November 2027), then every 2 years because of Lynch syndrome.
- CEA blood test every 6 months - Dr Vancell can take this in Malta and send us the result.

Your family
Lynch syndrome can run in families. Your sister Nuala Seoighe and other blood relatives can be offered a test for the same change. I have referred you to the clinical genetics service, who will write to you and can prepare a letter for your family.

Contact
If you have questions, please ring our cancer nurse line and ask for Darragh Mac Diarmada, Staff Nurse (NMBI PIN 749888).

Your next appointment is Thursday 14 January 2027 in my clinic.

Geachte collega's,

Wij berichten u over het ontslag van uw patiënt dhr. Haafkes, 55 jaar, die vandaag na ruim drie weken opname naar huis is gegaan.

Reden van opname
Op maandag 26-10-2026 bezocht dhr. Haafkes zijn echtgenote Esmee Haafkes, die op de afdeling gynaecologie lag na een hysterectomie. Op de afdeling raakte hij ontremd en achtervolgingswaanachtig, sloeg een glazen deur in en verwondde daarbij zijn rechterhand. Hij duwde een verpleegkundige van de afdeling tegen de grond. De politie is gewaarschuwd en hij werd aangehouden. Na beoordeling is door de burgemeester een crisismaatregel (Wvggz) opgelegd en is hij op de PAAZ opgenomen, nadat zijn handwond op de SEH was verzorgd. De rechter heeft de crisismaatregel op 29-10-2026 voortgezet; op 02-11-2026 is de maatregel beëindigd omdat er geen ernstig nadeel meer was. Daarna is hij vrijwillig gebleven.

Diagnose
- Bipolaire I-stoornis, eerste manische episode met psychotische kenmerken
- Snijwond rechterhand met letsel van de extensorpezen (zone VI)

Incident en justitiële situatie
Van de mishandeling van de verpleegkundige is aangifte gedaan door Gijs Zuurveld, gynaecoloog, afdelingshoofd (BIG 76615672795). De strafzaak ligt bij het Openbaar Ministerie; over de afloop is ons niets bekend en verdere informatie wordt niet in het medisch dossier opgenomen. Dhr. Haafkes heeft spijt betuigd en wil, als dat mogelijk is, zijn excuses aanbieden.

Somatisch beloop
De wond is op 26-10-2026 behandeld door Sem Bokkers, chirurg (BIG 31363892915): herstel van de extensorpezen zone VI. Wondgenezing ongestoord. Hij draagt een spalk tot 23-11-2026 en volgt daarna handtherapie via de polikliniek chirurgie.

Psychiatrisch beloop
Bij opname was hij manisch, met een sterk verminderde slaapbehoefte, gedachtevlucht en grootheidswanen. Er was geen middelengebruik (urinescreening negatief). Er is gestart met olanzapine en, na controle van nier- en schildklierfunctie (TSH normaal, kreatinine normaal), met lithium. De stemming normaliseerde in de loop van week twee; de psychotische symptomen verdwenen. Hij slaapt nu 7 uur per nacht en heeft goed ziekte-inzicht. Er is psycho-educatie gegeven aan hem en zijn echtgenote.

Medicatie bij ontslag
- Lithiumcarbonaat 800 mg 1dd (spiegel 0,8 mmol/l op 17-11-2026)
- Olanzapine 10 mg a.n.; na 4 weken afbouwen naar 5 mg a.n.
Geen andere medicatie. Let op interacties met NSAID's en diuretica en op voldoende vochtinname.

Signaleringsplan
Vroege signalen: minder dan 5 uur slaap, snel praten, veel geld uitgeven, prikkelbaarheid, veel nieuwe plannen.
Wat Michiel doet: op tijd naar bed, geen alcohol, de extra dosis olanzapine volgens afspraak innemen en het FACT-team bellen.

Opsummering af genetisk rådgivning – arvelig bryst- og æggestokkræft (BRCA2)

Navn: Volkan Akbaş
CPR-nr.: 040800-4519
Fødselsdato: 04.08.2000
Kopi: Sygehus Hjortehøj, att. overlæge Peter Eilersen

Kære Volkan

Tak for samtalen i dag. Her er en kort opsummering af det, vi talte om.

Dit resultat
Du er heterozygot for BRCA2 c.9097dup (p.Thr3033Asnfs*11), som er en sygdomsfremkaldende (patogen) variant. Det er den samme variant, som er fundet hos din mor. Analysen er udført af bioanalytiker Camilla Brogaard og vurderet af mig.

Familien
Din mor fik brystkræft som 49-årig, og din mormors søster havde æggestokkræft som 58-årig. Familien er af kurdisk-tyrkisk oprindelse; det har vi noteret, fordi det indgår i vurderingen af varianten.

Hvad betyder det for dig
Mænd med en BRCA2-variant har en livstidsrisiko for brystkræft på ca. 6-8 %, mod under 0,1 % for mænd generelt, og risikoen for prostatakræft er øget. Tallene gælder for grupper og ikke for den enkelte. Vi anbefaler:
– månedlig selvundersøgelse af brystet – henvend dig til egen læge ved knuder eller sår ved brystvorten
– PSA-måling årligt fra 40-årsalderen

Dine slægtninge
Dine søstre på 18 og 23 år har hver 50 % sandsynlighed for at bære varianten og tilbydes rådgivning og test. Det samme gælder dine fremtidige børn. Vedlagt er et familiebrev, som du kan give videre. Felterne "[Navn på slægtning]" og "[CPR-nr.]" udfyldes af den, der modtager brevet.

Betaling
Analysen er udført efter aftale med Sygehus Hjortehøj og afregnes mellem laboratoriet og sygehuset til 4.950 kr. pr. test. Du skal ikke betale noget.

Plan
– Kopi af resultatet sendes til din egen læge, som du gav samtykke til i dag.
– Henvisning til urologisk og mammakirurgisk opfølgning fra 40-årsalderen.
– Ønsker en af dine søstre test, booker vi en ny samtale.
